MONSTER BEVERAGE
REPORTS 2026 THIRD QUARTER FINANCIAL RESULTS
2026 Third Quarter Highlights
| · | Net
Sales rise 16.7 percent to $2.56 billion |
| · | Net
Sales to Customers Outside the United States increase 28.1 percent to $1.20 billion, representing
47 percent of total Net Sales |
| · | Net
Income Per Diluted Share increases 7.8 percent to $0.29 per share (8.5 percent to $0.30 per
share on a non-GAAP adjusted basis) 1 |
1 The tables at the end
of this press release provide a reconciliation of non-GAAP financial measures to the Company’s results, as reported under GAAP.
(See “Reconciliation of GAAP and Non-GAAP Information” below.)
Corona, CA
– November 5, 2026 – Monster Beverage Corporation (NASDAQ: MNST) today reported financial results for the three- and
nine-months ended September 30, 2026.
Net sales for the
2026 third quarter increased 16.7 percent to $2.56 billion, from $2.20 billion in the same period last year. Net changes in foreign currency
exchange rates had a favorable impact on net sales for the 2026 third quarter of $8.1 million. Net sales on a foreign currency adjusted
basis (non-GAAP) increased 16.3 percent in the 2026 third quarter.
Net sales, excluding
the Alcohol Brands segment (non-GAAP), increased 17.1 percent in the 2026 third quarter. Net sales, excluding the Alcohol Brands segment,
on a foreign currency adjusted basis (non-GAAP), increased 16.7 percent in the 2026 third quarter.
Net sales for the
Company’s Monster Energy® Drinks segment, which primarily includes the Company’s Monster Energy® drinks, Reign Total
Body Fuel® high performance energy drinks, Bang Energy® drinks, Storm™ and Reign Storm® total wellness energy
drinks and FLRT™ total wellness energy drinks, increased 17.1 percent to $2.37 billion for the 2026 third quarter, from $2.03
billion for the 2025 third quarter. Net changes in foreign currency exchange rates had a favorable impact on net sales for the Monster
Energy® Drinks segment of approximately $7.5 million for the 2026 third quarter. Net sales on a foreign currency adjusted basis (non-GAAP)
for the Monster Energy® Drinks segment increased 16.7 percent in the 2026 third quarter.
(more)
Monster
Beverage Corporation
2-2-2
Net sales for
the Company’s Strategic Brands segment, which primarily includes the various energy drink brands acquired from The Coca-Cola
Company, as well as the Company’s affordable energy brands, Predator® and Fury®, increased 19.8 percent to $156.4
million for the 2026 third quarter, from $130.5 million in the 2025 third quarter. Net changes in foreign currency exchange rates
had a favorable impact on net sales for the Strategic Brands segment of approximately $0.6 million for the 2026 third quarter. Net
sales on a foreign currency adjusted basis (non-GAAP) for the Strategic Brands segment increased 19.3 percent in the 2026 third
quarter.
Net sales for the
Alcohol Brands segment, which is comprised of various craft beers, flavored malt beverages and hard seltzers, decreased 13.6 percent
to $28.5 million for the 2026 third quarter, from $33.0 million in the 2025 third quarter.
Net sales for the
Company’s Other segment, which primarily includes certain products of American Fruits and Flavors, LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary
of the Company, sold to independent third-party customers, decreased 29.5 percent to $4.8 million for the 2026 third quarter, from $6.8
million in the 2025 third quarter.
Net sales to customers
outside the United States increased 28.1 percent to $1.20 billion in the 2026 third quarter, from $937.1 million in the 2025 third quarter,
representing approximately 47 percent and 43 percent of total reported net sales for the 2026 and 2025 third quarters, respectively.
Net sales to customers outside the United States, on a foreign currency adjusted basis (non-GAAP), increased 27.2 percent to $1.19 billion
in the 2026 third quarter.
Gross profit as
a percentage of net sales for the 2026 third quarter was 54.7 percent, compared with 55.7 percent in the 2025 third quarter. The decrease
in gross profit as a percentage of net sales for the 2026 third quarter was primarily the result of increased aluminum can costs, geographical
sales mix and increased freight-in costs, partially offset by pricing actions. Adjusted gross profit (non-GAAP) as a percentage of net
sales, excluding the Alcohol Brands segment, for the 2026 third quarter was 54.9 percent, compared with 56.2 percent in the 2025 third
quarter.
Distribution expenses
for the 2026 third quarter were $116.3 million, or 4.5 percent of net sales, compared with $82.6 million, or 3.8 percent of net sales,
in the 2025 third quarter. The increase in distribution expenses for the 2026 third quarter was primarily due to increased freight and
fuel expenses.
Selling expenses
for the 2026 third quarter were $260.1 million, or 10.1 percent of net sales, compared with $214.6 million, or 9.8 percent of net sales,
in the 2025 third quarter. The increase in selling expenses for the 2026 third quarter was primarily due to increased social, digital,
media and other marketing expenses, including sponsorships and endorsements, in order to reach a broader consumer audience and increase
household penetration.
General and administrative
expenses for the 2026 third quarter were $305.7 million, or 11.9 percent of net sales, compared with $251.9 million, or 11.5 percent
of net sales, for the 2025 third quarter. Stock-based compensation was $30.4 million for the 2026 third quarter, compared with $32.8
million in the 2025 third quarter. General and administrative expenses for the 2026 third quarter included a property and equipment impairment
charge of $19.9 million and expenses of $14.7 million related to the Company’s digital transformation initiatives. Adjusted general
and administrative expenses (non-GAAP) for the 2026 third quarter were $274.4 million, compared with $230.9 million in the 2025 third
quarter. Adjusted general and administrative expenses (non-GAAP) as a percentage of net sales, less the Alcohol Brands segment, were
10.8 percent and 10.7 percent for the 2026 and 2025 third quarters, respectively.
(more)
Monster
Beverage Corporation
3-3-3
Operating expenses
for the 2026 third quarter were $682.0 million, compared with $549.1 million in the 2025 third quarter. Operating expenses for the 2026
third quarter included a property and equipment impairment charge of $19.9 million and expenses of $14.7 million related to the Company’s
digital transformation initiatives. Adjusted operating expenses (non-GAAP) for the 2026 third quarter were $644.4 million, compared with
$517.8 million in the 2025 third quarter. Operating expenses as a percentage of net sales for the 2026 third quarter were 26.6 percent,
compared with 25.0 percent in the 2025 third quarter. Adjusted operating expenses (non-GAAP) as a percentage of net sales, less the Alcohol
Brands segment, were 25.4 percent and 23.9 percent for the 2026 and 2025 third quarters, respectively.
Operating income
for the 2026 third quarter increased 6.4 percent to $718.7 million, from $675.4 million in the 2025 third quarter. Adjusted operating
income (non-GAAP) for the 2026 third quarter increased 7.1 percent to $748.1 million, from $698.4 million in the 2025 third quarter.
The effective tax
rate for the 2026 third quarter was 24.6 percent, compared with 23.9 percent in the 2025 third quarter. The increase in the effective
tax rate was primarily due to a lower stock-based compensation deduction and an increase in income from higher income tax jurisdictions,
partially offset by a lower valuation allowance on foreign tax credit carryforwards.
Net income for the
2026 third quarter increased 8.4 percent to $568.4 million, from $524.5 million in the 2025 third quarter. Adjusted net income (non-GAAP)
for the 2026 third quarter increased 9.0 percent to $591.1 million, from $542.1 million in the 2025 third quarter. Net income per diluted
share for the 2026 third quarter increased 7.8 percent to $0.29, from $0.27 in the 2025 third quarter. Adjusted net income per diluted
share (non-GAAP) for the 2026 third quarter increased 8.5 percent to $0.30, from $0.28 in the 2025 third quarter.
Hilton H. Schlosberg,
Chief Executive Officer, said, “We delivered another quarter of strong top-line performance in both our domestic and international
markets, with record quarterly net sales increasing 16.7 percent to $2.56 billion.
“Our net sales
to customers outside the United States increased 28.1 percent in the 2026 third quarter to approximately 47 percent of total net sales.
LATAM, in particular, had a solid 2026 third quarter with net sales increasing 48.8 percent in dollars, primarily driven by our operations
in Brazil.
“During the
2026 third quarter, we continued our increased marketing investments across a variety of new platforms and partnerships, including social,
digital and media, to support both existing product offerings and new product launches, as well as reach a broadening consumer base for
the Company.
“Our new product
launches this quarter, including additions to the Monster Energy®, Java Monster®, Mother® and FLRT™ product lines,
reflect our ongoing commitment to innovation alongside the continued growth of our core offerings,” Mr. Schlosberg added.
2026 Nine-Months Results
Net sales for the
nine-months ended September 30, 2026 increased 20.9 percent to $7.45 billion, from $6.16 billion in the comparable period last year.
Net changes in foreign currency exchange rates had a favorable impact of $145.9 million on net sales for the nine-months ended September 30,
2026. Net sales on a foreign currency adjusted basis (non-GAAP) increased 18.6 percent in the nine-months ended September 30, 2026.
Net sales, excluding the Alcohol Brands segment, on a foreign currency adjusted basis (non-GAAP), increased 19.1 percent in the nine-months
ended September 30, 2026.
Gross profit as
a percentage of net sales for the nine-months ended September 30, 2026 was 55.2 percent, compared with 56.0 percent in the comparable
period last year.
(more)
Monster
Beverage Corporation
4-4-4
Operating expenses
for the nine-months ended September 30, 2026 were $1.92 billion, compared with $1.57 billion in the comparable period last year.
Operating income
for the nine-months ended September 30, 2026 increased to $2.19 billion, from $1.88 billion in the comparable period last year.
The effective tax
rate for the nine-months ended September 30, 2026 was 24.2 percent, compared with 23.9 percent in the comparable period last year.
Net income for the
nine-months ended September 30, 2026 increased 18.3 percent to $1.72 billion, from $1.46 billion in the comparable period last year.
Net income per diluted share for the nine-months ended September 30, 2026 was $0.87, compared with $0.74 in the comparable period
last year.
Share Repurchase Program
During the 2026
third quarter, the Company purchased approximately 2.3 million shares of its common stock at an average purchase price of $43.87 per
share, for a total amount of approximately $100.0 million. As of November 4, 2026, approximately $800.0 million remained available
for repurchase under the previously authorized repurchase programs.
Stock Split
As previously announced,
the Company’s Board of Directors approved and declared a two-for-one stock split of its common stock, effected in the form of a
100 percent stock dividend. The stock dividend was issued on August 10, 2026, and the Company’s common stock began trading
at the split-adjusted price on August 11, 2026.
Investor Conference Call
The Company will
host an investor conference call today, November 5, 2026, at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time (5:00 p.m. Eastern Time). The conference
call will be open to all interested investors through a live audio web broadcast via the internet at www.monsterbevcorp.com in the “Events &
Presentations” section. For those who are not able to listen to the live broadcast, the call will be archived for approximately
one year on the website.
Monster Beverage Corporation
Based in Corona,
California, Monster Beverage Corporation is a holding company and conducts no operating business except through its consolidated subsidiaries.
The Company’s subsidiaries develop and market energy drinks, including Monster Energy® drinks, Monster Energy Ultra® energy
drinks, Juice Monster® and Punch Monster® Energy + Juice energy drinks, Java Monster® and Monster Killer Brew® non-carbonated
coffee + energy drinks, Rehab® Monster® non-carbonated energy drinks, Monster Energy® Nitro energy drinks, Reign Total Body
Fuel® high performance energy drinks, Storm™ and Reign Storm® total wellness energy drinks, NOS® energy drinks,
Full Throttle® energy drinks, Bang Energy® drinks, FLRT™ total wellness energy drinks, BPM® energy drinks, BU®
energy drinks, Burn® energy drinks, Live+® energy drinks, Mother® energy drinks, Nalu® energy drinks, Play® and Power
Play® (stylized) energy drinks, Relentless® energy drinks, Samurai® energy drinks, Ultra Energy® drinks, Predator®
energy drinks and Fury® energy drinks. The Company’s subsidiaries also develop and market craft beers, flavored malt beverages
and hard seltzers under a number of brands, including Jai Alai® IPA, Dale’s Pale Ale®, Dallas Blonde®, Wild Basin®
hard seltzers, The Beast™, Blind Lemon® and Blinder Lemon™. For more information visit www.monsterbevcorp.com .
